## 85. Anangoog

**ٱلْبُرُوج** · Al-Buruj · Mekkan · 22 ikidowinan

*Giizhigong anangoog, miinawaa giizhigad gaa-ikidoyaan — anishinaabeg gaa-ayaawaad waazhining.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**85:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: giizhigong anangoog.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ

**85:2**  Miinawaa giizhigad gaa-ikidoyaan.

وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ

**85:3**  Miinawaa gaa-waabandamod miinawaa gaa-waabandanzigaadeg.

وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ

**85:4**  Gii-nishwanaaji'aagwaa anishinaabeg gaa-ayaawaad waazhining.

قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ

**85:5**  Ishkote gaa-miinaagozid mitigoon.

ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ

**85:6**  Aapiji gii-namadabiwaad o'omaa.

إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ

**85:7**  Miinawaa gii-waabandaanaawaa gaa-izhichigewaad debwe'endamojig.

وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ

**85:8**  Gaawiin gegoo gaa-onji-zhingewaawaad, debwe'endamowaad eta Allah Al-Aziiz, Al-Hamiid.

وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ

**85:9**  Weniwaad dibendaagozid giizhigong miinawaa aking; Allah waabandaan kina gegoo.

ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ

**85:10**  Gaa-gagwejitoowaad debwe'endamojig, ininiwag miinawaa ikwewag, giishpin gaawiin aanjigobiisiwag; gagwiinzhiwewin ishkoteng da-ayaanaawaa; gagwiinzhiwewin izhaateng da-ayaanaawaa.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ

**85:11**  Debwe'endamojig gaa-mino-doodamowaad da-ayaanaawaa Jannah ziibiwan gaa-bimijiwaang; mii awe gichi-mino-ayaawin.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ

**85:12**  Apiji mashkawaadizi gichi-Ogimaayan.

إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ

**85:13**  Wiin eta gaa-maajiitood miinawaa gaa-aabajitood.

إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ

**85:14**  Wiin eta Al-Ghafoor, Al-Waduud.

وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ

**85:15**  Debendang Gichi-Abiwin gichi-apiitendaagozid.

ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ

**85:16**  Doodam gaa-wii-doodang.

فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ

**85:17**  Giibi-ayaamagad na aadizookaaniwaad simaaganishag?

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ

**85:18**  Fir'awn miinawaa Thamud?

فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ

**85:19**  Geget, debwe'endasig aanjwebaajig.

بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ

**85:20**  Allah oshkiniijiking gii-gibwaakwenaan.

وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ

**85:21**  Geget, o'ow Quran gichi-apiitendaagozid.

بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ

**85:22**  Mazina'iganing gaa-ganaawenjigaadeg.

فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ

---

## 86. Dibik-anang

**ٱلطَّارِق** · At-Tariq · Mekkan · 17 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: giizhigong miinawaa dibik-anang: anang gaa-zaaga'amod, miinawaa jiibay gaa-ayaad ganaawenjigewinid.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**86:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: giizhigong miinawaa dibik-anang.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ

**86:2**  Aaniish gaa-wiindamaagoyen wegonen dibik-anang?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ

**86:3**  Anang gaa-zaaga'amod.

ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ

**86:4**  Gaawiin jiibay gaa-ayaasig ganaawenjigewinid.

إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ

**86:5**  Anishinaabe da-inaabandaan gaa-onji-ozhitood.

فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ

**86:6**  Gii-ozhitoo nibi gaa-biijiwang.

خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ

**86:7**  Bi-zaaga'amo nasaab ookan.

يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ

**86:8**  Geget da-gashkitoo da-aabijibaanad.

إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ

**86:9**  Giizhigad aapiji gaa-gazoodaamowaad da-waabanda'igaadewag.

يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ

**86:10**  Gaawiin da-ayaasii mashkawiziwin, gaawiin wiidookaaged.

فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ

**86:11**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: giizhigong gaa-aabajitood.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ

**86:12**  Miinawaa aki gaa-taaskibijigaadeg.

وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ

**86:13**  O'ow ikidowin gaa-izhi-diba'igaadeg.

إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ

**86:14**  Gaawiin o'ow baapinwewin.

وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ

**86:15**  Gii-maji-inaakonenidiwag.

إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا

**86:16**  Nin dash nindizhi-maji-inaakon.

وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا

**86:17**  Mii dash, bakaanen debwe'endasig — bekaan eta.

فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا

---

## 87. Gichi-apiitendaagozid

**ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ** · Al-A'la · Mekkan · 19 ikidowinan

*Mamakaadendan izhinikaazowin gichi-Ogimaayan, Gichi-apiitendaagozid, gaa-ozhitood miinawaa gaa-gwayak-izhi'aad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**87:1**  Mamakaadendan izhinikaazowin gichi-Ogimaayan, Gichi-apiitendaagozid.

سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى

**87:2**  Gaa-ozhitood miinawaa gaa-gwayak-izhi'aad.

ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ

**87:3**  Gaa-diba'iged miinawaa gaa-miikaansang.

وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ

**87:4**  Gaa-zaagijitood mashkosiwan.

وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ

**87:5**  Mii dash odizhi-izhi'aad biindaakoshkaag.

فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ

**87:6**  Ninga-agindoon, gego dash waniken.

سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ

**87:7**  Aapiji eta Allah gaa-wii-izhiwebak. Ogikendaan gaa-ikidoyaag miinawaa gaa-gazoodaamowaad.

إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ

**87:8**  Ninga-wawenizhitoonaan giin miikana gaa-wawenizid.

وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

**87:9**  Mii dash mikinawenjigen, giishpin mikinawenjigewin mino-doodam.

فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

**87:10**  Gaa-gotamid da-mikwendaan.

سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ

**87:11**  Gaa-aakozidamid dash da-aanjwebin.

وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى

**87:12**  Gaa-biindiged gichi-ishkote.

ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ

**87:13**  Ii'iw gaawiin da-nibosii, gaawiin da-bimaadizisii.

ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ

**87:14**  Mino-ayaa gaa-biina'idizod.

قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ

**87:15**  Miinawaa gaa-mikwendang izhinikaazowin Ogimaamiwan, gii-ayami'aad.

وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ

**87:16**  Giinawaa dash ginandawaabandaanaawaa bimaadiziwin noongom.

بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا

**87:17**  Ishkwaa-bimaadiziwin dash nahaaw mino-ayaamagad, apiji gaagige.

وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ

**87:18**  O'ow ayaamagad mazina'iganan gaa-niigaaniiyaag.

إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

**87:19**  Mazina'iganiwaad Ibraahiim miinawaa Muusaa.

صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ

---

## 88. Gagwejiwewin

**ٱلْغَاشِيَة** · Al-Ghashiyah · Mekkan · 26 ikidowinan

*Giibi-ayaamagad na gikendamowin gaa-gagweji'aagowaad? Zhaangweshiwag ii'iw Giizhigad da-agwajiinaagozijig, gaye da-waaseyaawag.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**88:1**  Giibi-ayaamagad na gikendamowin gaa-gagweji'aagowaad?

هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ

**88:2**  Zhaangweshiwag ii'iw Giizhigad da-agwajiinaagozijig.

وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ

**88:3**  Aakozijig, gii-ayaakozijig.

عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ

**88:4**  Da-izhaatewag gichi-izhaateng.

تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ

**88:5**  Da-minikaagoziwag mookijiwaning gaa-izhaateg.

تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ

**88:6**  Gaawiin da-ayaanaawaa miijim, asaag eta.

لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ

**88:7**  Gaawiin da-wiisini'igosiiwag, gaawiin da-gii-pooni-bakadesiiwag.

لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ

**88:8**  Zhaangweshiwag ii'iw Giizhigad da-minwendamowaad.

وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ

**88:9**  Minwendamowaad gaa-izhichigewaad onji.

لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ

**88:10**  Ishpiming Jannah.

فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ

**88:11**  Ii'iw gaawiin da-noondanziin maji-ikidowin.

لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ

**88:12**  Ii'iw ayaamagad mookijiwan gaa-bimijiwaag.

فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ

**88:13**  Ii'iw ayaanag apabiwinan gaa-ishpinaabidegin.

فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ

**88:14**  Miinawaa minikwaaganan gaa-ayaajigaadegin.

وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ

**88:15**  Miinawaa apabwinensag gaa-ayaajigaadegin.

وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ

**88:16**  Miinawaa abwewinan gaa-zhaazhaabokijigaadegin.

وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ

**88:17**  Gaawiin na naanaagadawaabanjigesiiwag ibiilan — aaniin gaa-izhi'igaazod?

أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

**88:18**  Miinawaa giizhigong — aaniin gaa-izhi'igaadeg?

وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ

**88:19**  Miinawaa wajiwaag — aaniin gaa-izhi'igaadewag?

وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ

**88:20**  Miinawaa aki — aaniin gaa-izhi'igaadeg?

وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ

**88:21**  Mii dash mikinawenjigen. Giin eta mikinawenjige.

فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ

**88:22**  Gaawiin gidibendaagozisiiwag.

لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ

**88:23**  Aw dash gaa-aanjwebid miinawaa gaa-debwe'endasig.

إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ

**88:24**  Allah da-gagwiinzhi'aad gichi-gagwiinzhiwewin.

فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ

**88:25**  Niinawind eta gaa-bi-izhaawaad.

إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ

**88:26**  Mii dash niinawind gaa-onji-diba'igewaad.

ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم

---

## 89. Waaban

**ٱلْفَجْر** · Al-Fajr · Mekkan · 30 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: waaban, miinawaa midaasogon dibikag, miinawaa gaa-niizhwaad miinawaa gaa-bezhigwaad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**89:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: waaban.

وَٱلْفَجْرِ

**89:2**  Miinawaa midaasogon dibikag.

وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ

**89:3**  Miinawaa gaa-niizhwaad miinawaa gaa-bezhigwaad.

وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ

**89:4**  Miinawaa dibik aapiji gaa-maajaad.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ

**89:5**  Ayaamagad na gichi-ikidowin gaa-nitaa-inendamod?

هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ

**89:6**  Giwaabandaan na aaniin gaa-izhi'aawaad gichi-Ogimaayan Aad?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ

**89:7**  Iram gaa-ayaad aabitaawaabikong.

إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ

**89:8**  Gaawiin awiya gaa-izhi'igaazosii noongom aking.

ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

**89:9**  Miinawaa Thamud — gaa-ozhitoowaad wiigiwaaman asin waadinaang.

وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ

**89:10**  Miinawaa Fir'awn gaa-ayaad aabitaawaabikon.

وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

**89:11**  Gaa-maji-izhichigewaad aking.

ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ

**89:12**  Apiji gii-maji-izhichigewag o'omaa.

فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ

**89:13**  Mii dash gichi-Ogimaayan gii-niisaabikiwad gagwiinzhiwewin.

فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ

**89:14**  Gichi-Ogimaayan ganaam.

إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ

**89:15**  Anishinaabe dash, aapiji Ogimaamiwad gaa-gagwejitood, gii-gichi-apiitendaagood, gii-mino-doodaagood, ikido: "Ogimaam ngii-gichi-apiitend."

فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ

**89:16**  Aapiji dash gaa-gagwejitood, gii-maanadaagood bimaadiziwining, ikido: "Ogimaam ngii-agaji'."

وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

**89:17**  Gaawiin. Giinawaa dash gaawiin gichi-apiitenimaasiiwaag yatiiman.

كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**89:18**  Gaawiin giwiindamaasiwaawaa wiisini'igowaad kitimaagizijig.

وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**89:19**  Giwiisininaawaa gaa-ishkwaasejigaadeg apiji.

وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا

**89:20**  Giwizaagi'anaawaa zhoonyaa apiji.

وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا

**89:21**  Gaawiin — aapiji aki gaa-zhaazhiibijigaadeg, gaa-baaka'igaadeg.

كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا

**89:22**  Miinawaa gichi-Ogimaayan da-bi-izhaa, miinawaa Aanjelag, nitaawigi'idiwaad.

وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا

**89:23**  Ii'iw Giizhigad, ishkote da-bi-izhiwizh; ii'iw Giizhigad, anishinaabe da-mikwendam, aaniish dash gaa-onji-mino-doodaagood mikwendamowin?

وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ

**89:24**  Da-ikido: "Aapiji sa ningii-niigaaniiwe bimaadiziwining!"

يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى

**89:25**  Ii'iw Giizhigad, gaawiin awiya da-gagwiinzhi'aasii gaa-izhi-gagwiinzhi'aad.

فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ

**89:26**  Gaawiin awiya da-takobinaasii gaa-izhi-takobinaad.

وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ

**89:27**  Giin dash, o jiibay gaa-minwendamid.

يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ

**89:28**  Giiwen Ogimaayan, minwendamid miinawaa debwe'endamowaa.

ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ

**89:29**  Biindigen nindanokiiwinaaning.

فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى

**89:30**  Biindigen ninJannahning.

وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى

---

## 90. Oodena

**ٱلْبَلَد** · Al-Balad · Mekkan · 20 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: o'ow oodena — anishinaabe gaa-ozhitood aakozidamowining.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**90:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: o'ow oodena.

لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

**90:2**  Giin dash gidaa-ayaa o'ow oodena.

وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ

**90:3**  Miinawaa gichi-ikidoyaan: oosaan miinawaa obijaanisan.

وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ

**90:4**  Niinawind gii-ozhitoonaan anishinaabe aakozidamowining.

لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ

**90:5**  Inendam na gaawiin awiya da-gashkitoosig?

أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ

**90:6**  Ikido: "Ningii-zhaagijiwebin zhoonyaa apiji."

يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا

**90:7**  Inendam na gaawiin awiya gaa-waabamigod?

أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ

**90:8**  Gaawiin na gii-miinaasiinaag niizh oshkiinzhigoyan?

أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ

**90:9**  Miinawaa odan miinawaa niizh doonan?

وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ

**90:10**  Miinawaa gii-waabanda'igoonaan niizh miikanan?

وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ

**90:11**  Gaawiin dash gii-aakozisii gaa-izhaad ishpiming miikanang.

فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ

**90:12**  Aaniish gaa-wiindamaagoyen wegonen ishpiming miikan?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ

**90:13**  Aabajitood anokiiwinini.

فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ

**90:14**  Gaye wiisini'igod giizhigad gaa-bakaded.

أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ

**90:15**  Yatiim wiijiikiwen.

يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ

**90:16**  Gaye kitimaagizi gaa-ayaad pingwining.

أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ

**90:17**  Mii dash ayaawid debwe'endamojig, gaa-nanaakonenidiwaad zoongide'ewin miinawaa zhawenjigewin.

ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ

**90:18**  O'oog anishinaabeg gaa-mino-ayaawaad.

أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ

**90:19**  Gaa-aanjwebijig dash nindizhi-waabanda'iwewininaan — o'oog anishinaabeg gaa-aakozidamowaad.

وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ

**90:20**  Ogo da-agwajiibiwaag ishkoteng gaa-gibahaadeg.

عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ

---

## 91. Giizis

**ٱلشَّمْس** · Ash-Shams · Mekkan · 15 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: giizis miinawaa waaseyaa, miinawaa jiibay miinawaa gaa-gwayak-izhi'aad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**91:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: giizis miinawaa waaseyaa.

وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا

**91:2**  Miinawaa dibik-giizis aapiji gaa-noopanaad.

وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا

**91:3**  Miinawaa giizhigad aapiji gaa-waabanda'iged.

وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا

**91:4**  Miinawaa dibik aapiji gaa-gibwaakwaad.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا

**91:5**  Miinawaa giizhigong miinawaa gaa-ozhitood.

وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا

**91:6**  Miinawaa aki miinawaa gaa-zhaazhiibidood.

وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا

**91:7**  Miinawaa jiibay miinawaa gaa-gwayak-izhi'aad.

وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا

**91:8**  Gii-gikendamo'oon jiibay maji-doodamowin miinawaa mino-doodamowin.

فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا

**91:9**  Mino-ayaa gaa-biina'idood.

قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا

**91:10**  Wanishin gaa-maji-izhi'aad.

وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا

**91:11**  Thamud gii-aanjwebi gichi-inendaagozid.

كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ

**91:12**  Aapiji gaa-noopanaawaad apiji gaa-maji-doodamid.

إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا

**91:13**  Rasuul Allah ogii-inaan: "O'ow ikwe-ibiil Allah, miizh minikwen."

فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا

**91:14**  Gii-aanjwebinaawaad dash, gii-nisaawaad ikwe-ibiilan. Mii dash Ogimaamiwaad gii-nishwanaaji'aawaan maji-izhichigewiniwaad onji, gii-zhaazhiibidoon.

فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

**91:15**  Gaawiin ogotanziin gaa-bi-ayaamagak.

وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا

---

## 92. Dibik

**ٱللَّيْل** · Al-Layl · Mekkan · 21 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: dibik aapiji gaa-gibwaakwaad, miinawaa giizhigad aapiji gaa-waaseyaag — miigiwewin miinawaa gotamowin.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**92:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: dibik aapiji gaa-gibwaakwaad.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ

**92:2**  Miinawaa giizhigad aapiji gaa-waaseyaag.

وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ

**92:3**  Miinawaa gaa-ozhitood ininiwan miinawaa ikwewan.

وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ

**92:4**  Geget, gaa-izhichigeyeg bakaan.

إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ

**92:5**  Aw gaa-miigiwewad miinawaa gaa-gotamid.

فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ

**92:6**  Miinawaa gaa-debwe'endamod mino-ayaawin.

وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

**92:7**  Ninga-wawenizhitoonaanad miikana gaa-wawenizid.

فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ

**92:8**  Aw dash gaa-sasagendang miinawaa gaa-dibenindizod.

وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ

**92:9**  Miinawaa gaa-aanjwebid mino-ayaawin.

وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ

**92:10**  Ninga-izhi'aanaanaad miikana gaa-aakozid.

فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ

**92:11**  Gaawiin da-wiidookaagosii zhoonyaamiwan aapiji gaa-bangishimod.

وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ

**92:12**  Niinawind eta gaa-miikaansang.

إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ

**92:13**  Niinawind dibendaagoziwag ishkwaa-ayaag miinawaa niigaaniiyaag.

وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ

**92:14**  Ningii-nanaakoninim gichi-izhaate.

فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ

**92:15**  Gaawiin awiya da-izhaatesii apiji gaa-maji-doodamojig eta.

لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى

**92:16**  Gaa-aanjwebid miinawaa gaa-giiweshkwed.

ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ

**92:17**  Gaa-gotamid dash da-aazhawed.

وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى

**92:18**  Gaa-miigiwewad zhoonyaamiwan wii-biina'idizod.

ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ

**92:19**  Gaawiin odizhi-nandawaabandanziin miigwewin.

وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ

**92:20**  Nandawaabandaan eta minwendamowin Ogimaamiwan, Gichi-apiitendaagozid.

إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ

**92:21**  Miinawaa da-minwendam.

وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ

---

## 93. Naawakwe

**ٱلضُّحَىٰ** · Ad-Duha · Mekkan · 11 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: naawakwe: gichi-Ogimaayan gaawiin gii-nagadanziig, gaawiin gii-zhingenimigosii.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**93:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: naawakwe.

وَٱلضُّحَىٰ

**93:2**  Miinawaa dibik aapiji gaa-pi-ayaag.

وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ

**93:3**  Gichi-Ogimaayan gaawiin gii-nagadanziig, gaawiin gii-wanenimigosii.

مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ

**93:4**  Ishkwaa-bimaadiziwin nahaaw mino-ayaamagad giin, niigaanii-bimaadiziwin.

وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ

**93:5**  Miinawaa gichi-Ogimaayan da-miinig, da-minwendaman.

وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ

**93:6**  Gaawiin na gii-mikawisig yatiimiyan, gii-gizhaabewizid?

أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ

**93:7**  Miinawaa gii-mikawig gaa-wanishinid, gii-miikaansh.

وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ

**93:8**  Miinawaa gii-mikawig gaa-kitimaagiziyan, gii-wii-mino-ayaayan.

وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ

**93:9**  Mii dash, gego aakozhi'aaken yatiiman.

فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ

**93:10**  Gego aanjwebin gaa-nandotamawid.

وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ

**93:11**  Wiindamaw dash mino-doodaagwin gichi-Ogimaayan.

وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ

---

## 94. Baakibijigan

**ٱلشَّرْح** · Ash-Sharh · Mekkan · 8 ikidowinan

*Gaawiin na gii-baakibidoonaag ode'in? Gii-odaapinaanaan gegoo gaa-aakozhi'igoyan.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**94:1**  Gaawiin na gii-baakibidoonaag ode'in?

أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

**94:2**  Gii-odaapinaanaan gaa-aakozhi'igoyan.

وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ

**94:3**  Gaa-aakozhi'igoyan oshkiniijiking?

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ

**94:4**  Gii-ishpinaanaag izhinikaazowin.

وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ

**94:5**  Aakozidamowin dash, mino-ayaawin da-ayaamagad.

فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

**94:6**  Aakozidamowin dash, mino-ayaawin da-ayaamagad.

إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا

**94:7**  Aapiji gaa-giizhiwebak anokiiwin, anama'en.

فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ

**94:8**  Miinawaa gichi-Ogimaayan izhaan, nandotamaw.

وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب

---

## 95. Fiig

**ٱلتِّين** · At-Tin · Mekkan · 8 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: fiig miinawaa zaytuun, miinawaa Sinai wajiw, miinawaa o'ow oodena gaa-gizhaabewizid.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**95:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: fiig miinawaa zaytuun.

بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ

**95:2**  Miinawaa Sinai wajiw.

وَطُورِ سِينِينَ

**95:3**  Miinawaa o'ow oodena gaa-gizhaabewizid.

وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ

**95:4**  Niinawind gii-ozhitoonaan anishinaabe apiji gaa-mino-izhi'aad.

لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ

**95:5**  Mii dash gii-izhi'aanaanaad apiji gaa-niisaad.

ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ

**95:6**  Debwe'endamojig eta miinawaa gaa-mino-doodamowaad; gaawiin da-ishkwaasinoon miigwewiniwaad.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ

**95:7**  Aaniish dash gaa-onji-aanjwebiyan ayaami'aawin?

فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**95:8**  Allah na gaawiin Al-Hakiim apiji debakonigewininiwag?

أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ

---

## 96. Aginzoowin

**ٱلْعَلَق** · Al-Alaq · Mekkan · 19 ikidowinan

*Agindan, izhinikaazowin gichi-Ogimaayan gaa-ozhitood — gii-ozhitood anishinaabe aginzood.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**96:1**  Agindan: izhinikaazowin gichi-Ogimaayan gaa-ozhitood.

ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ

**96:2**  Gii-ozhitood anishinaabe aginzood.

خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ

**96:3**  Agindan: gichi-Ogimaayan eta Al-Kariim.

ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ

**96:4**  Gaa-gikinoo'amaaged mazina'ibii'igan.

ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ

**96:5**  Gii-gikinoo'amaawaan anishinaabe gaa-gaawiin-gikendanzig.

عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ

**96:6**  Geget, anishinaabe aapiji maji-izhichige.

كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ

**96:7**  Aapiji gaa-dibenindizod.

أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ

**96:8**  Gichi-Ogimaayan dash eta gaa-bi-izhaad.

إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ

**96:9**  Giwaabandaan na gaa-naanaakobid?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ

**96:10**  Anokiiwininiwan aapiji gaa-ayami'aad?

عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ

**96:11**  Inendam na miikanang gaa-ayaad?

أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ

**96:12**  Gaye gaa-ganoonad mino-doodamowin?

أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ

**96:13**  Giwaabandaan na aaniin gaa-aanjwebid miinawaa gaa-giiweshkwed?

أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ

**96:14**  Gaawiin na ogikendaanziin Allah gaa-waabamid?

أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ

**96:15**  Gaawiin. Giishpin gaawiin boonitoosiid, ninga-wiikobinaanaag nisiding.

كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

**96:16**  Nisid gaa-gagwaadagid, maji-izhichiged.

نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ

**96:17**  Maajii-nandomaad wiijiikiwenyin.

فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ

**96:18**  Niinawind dash ninga-nandomaanaag ganaawenjigewinijig.

سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ

**96:19**  Gaawiin, gego noondawiken; ayaamoyaan, biinaagoshin.  
*[ayaamoyaa — maajii-doodam]*

كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩

---

## 97. Qadr

**ٱلْقَدْر** · Al-Qadr · Mekkan · 5 ikidowinan

*Niinawind gii-niisaabikiimin Dibikad Qadr — mino-ayaawin eta, waaban gaa-pi-ayaag.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**97:1**  Niinawind gii-niisaabikiimin Dibikad Qadr.

بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ

**97:2**  Aaniish gaa-wiindamaagoyen wegonen Dibikad Qadr?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ

**97:3**  Dibikad Qadr nahaaw mino-ayaamagad, midaaswaak giizisoog.

لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ

**97:4**  Ii'iw da-niisaawag Aanjelag miinawaa Ar-Ruuh, Ogimaamiwaad gaa-izhi-miinaawaad, kina gaa-izhichigaadeg.

تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ

**97:5**  Mino-ayaawin eta; waaban gaa-pi-ayaag.

سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ

---

## 98. Waabanda'iwewin

**ٱلْبَيِّنَة** · Al-Bayyinah · Medinan · 8 ikidowinan

*Debwe'endasig anishinaabeg gaa-ayaawaad mazina'iganiwaad miinawaa mushrikijig gaawiin gii-boonitoosiinag.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**98:1**  Debwe'endasig anishinaabeg gaa-ayaawaad mazina'iganiwaad miinawaa mushrikijig, gaawiin gii-boonitoosiinag, Waabanda'iwewin gaa-bi-ayaag.

لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

**98:2**  Rasuul Allah gaa-agindang mazina'iganan gaa-biinaadegin.

رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ

**98:3**  Ii'iw ayaamagad mazina'iganan gaa-apiitendaagozid.

فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ

**98:4**  Gaa-miinaawaad mazina'igan gaawiin gii-baaka'idiisiwag, Waabanda'iwewin eta gaa-bi-ayaag.

وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

**98:5**  Gaawiin gegoo gaa-izhi-ganoonaawaad, anama'awaad eta Allah, debwe'endamowaad wiin eta, miinawaa izhichigewaad Salat, miinawaa miigiwewaad. Mii awe ayaami'aawin gaa-gwayak.

وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ

**98:6**  Debwe'endasig anishinaabeg gaa-ayaawaad mazina'iganiwaad miinawaa mushrikijig da-ayaawag ishkoteng, gaagige da-ayaawag o'omaa. O'oog apiji gaa-maji-ayaawaad.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

**98:7**  Debwe'endamojig dash gaa-mino-bimaadiziwaad — o'oog apiji gaa-mino-ayaawaad.

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

**98:8**  Miigwewiniwaad ayaamagad Ogimaamiwaang: Gaagige-Jannah ziibiwan gaa-bimijiwaang, gaagige da-ayaawag o'omaa. Allah minwendamowaad, wiinawaa minwendamowaad Wiin. Mii awe gaa-gotamid Ogimaamiwan.

جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ

---

## 99. Ningwaakiiwewin

**ٱلزَّلْزَلَة** · Az-Zalzalah · Medinan · 8 ikidowinan

*Aapiji aki gaa-ningwaakiiyaag, miinawaa gaa-zaagijitood gaa-aakozhi'igod.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**99:1**  Aapiji aki gaa-ningwaakiiyaag.

إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا

**99:2**  Miinawaa aki da-zaagijitood gaa-aakozhi'igod.

وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا

**99:3**  Miinawaa anishinaabe da-ikido: "Wegonen o'ow?"

وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا

**99:4**  Ii'iw Giizhigad, da-dibaajimon.

يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا

**99:5**  Gichi-Ogimaayan gaa-izhi-gikinoo'amaagood.

بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا

**99:6**  Ii'iw Giizhigad, anishinaabeg da-zaagijiwaag, da-waabanda'igowaad gaa-izhichigewaad.

يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ

**99:7**  Awiya gaa-izhichiged mino-ayaawin, apiji gaa-agasaag, da-waabandaan.

فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ

**99:8**  Miinawaa awiya gaa-izhichiged maji-ayaawin, apiji gaa-agasaag, da-waabandaan.

وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ

---

## 100. Gaa-bimibatoowaad

**ٱلْعَادِيَات** · Al-Adiyat · Mekkan · 11 ikidowinan

*Gichi-ikidoyaan: gaa-bimibatoowaad gaa-aakozinewaad, ishkotensan gaa-zaagijitoowaad, waaban gaa-maazhiitaawaad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**100:1**  Gichi-ikidoyaan: gaa-bimibatoowaad gaa-aakozinewaad.

وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا

**100:2**  Ishkotensan gaa-zaagijitoowaad.

فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا

**100:3**  Waaban gaa-maazhiitaawaad.

فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا

**100:4**  Pingwin gaa-ombijitoowaad.

فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا

**100:5**  Nasaab gaa-izhaawaad.

فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا

**100:6**  Geget, anishinaabe gaawiin miigwechiwesii Ogimaamiwan.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ

**100:7**  Miinawaa ogikendaan o'ow.

وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ

**100:8**  Miinawaa apiji zaagi'aa zhoonyaa.

وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ

**100:9**  Gaawiin na ogikendaanziin? Aapiji gaa-ayaag ningwa'igananing da-zhaazhaabokideg.

۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ

**100:10**  Miinawaa gaa-ayaag ode'idewaang da-waabanda'igaade.

وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ

**100:11**  Ogimaamiwaad, ii'iw Giizhigad, apiji ogikendaanaawaan.

إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ

---

## 101. Gichi-inendaagwak

**ٱلْقَارِعَة** · Al-Qari'ah · Mekkan · 11 ikidowinan

*Gichi-inendaagwak: giizhigad aapiji anishinaabeg da-ayaawag memegwaag gaa-zhaazhaabokidewaad, wajiwaag da-ayaawag nookaadeshin.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**101:1**  Gichi-inendaagwak.

ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:2**  Wegonen gichi-inendaagwak?

مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:3**  Aaniish gaa-wiindamaagoyen wegonen gichi-inendaagwak?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ

**101:4**  Giizhigad aapiji anishinaabeg da-ayaawag memegwaag gaa-zhaazhaabokidewaad.

يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ

**101:5**  Miinawaa wajiwaag da-ayaawag nookaadeshin.

وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ

**101:6**  Aw gaa-mashkawaad diba'iganaak.

فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:7**  Da-ayaa bimaadiziwining gaa-minwendagwak.

فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ

**101:8**  Aw dash gaa-waaniid diba'iganaak.

وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ

**101:9**  O'ow gaa-ayaad: Haawiyah.

فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ

**101:10**  Giwii-gikendan na wegonen o'ow?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ

**101:11**  Ishkote gaa-gichi-izhaateg.

نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ

---

## 102. Ninaagibinaaganiwin

**ٱلتَّكَاثُر** · At-Takathur · Mekkan · 8 ikidowinan

*Ninaagibinaaganiwin aanjwebinigoog, baamaa ji-izhaayeg jiibayikaaning.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**102:1**  Ninaagibinaaganiwin aanjwebinigoog.

أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ

**102:2**  Baamaa ji-izhaayeg jiibayikaaning.

حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ

**102:3**  Geget, da-gikendang.

كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:4**  Miinawaa geget, da-gikendang.

ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ

**102:5**  Gishpin debwe-gikendameg.

كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:6**  Da-waabandaanawaa ishkote.

لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ

**102:7**  Miinawaa da-waabandaanawaa debwe-waabandamowining.

ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ

**102:8**  Miinawaa iwidi giizhigad, da-gagwejimigoog minwaadiziwining onji.

ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

---

## 103. Aabaajishkaamagad Giizhigad

**ٱلْعَصْر** · Al-Asr · Mekkan · 3 ikidowinan

*Giizhigad — geget sa: anishinaabe banadizi, aabiding wenjiik debwe'endamojig, mino-doodamowaad, debwewin wiindamowaad, gaye zoongide'ewin wiindamowaad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**103:1**  Giizhigad — geget sa!

وَٱلْعَصْرِ

**103:2**  Anishinaabe banadizi.

إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ

**103:3**  Aabiding wenjiik debwe'endamojig, mino-doodamowaad, debwewin wiindamowaad, gaye zoongide'ewin wiindamowaad.

إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ

---

## 104. Gaagiimid

**ٱلْهُمَزَة** · Al-Humazah · Mekkan · 9 ikidowinan

*Nishkaadizi awiya gaagiimid, wenji-maawanji'idod maamakaadiziwin, agindaasod.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**104:1**  Nishkaadizi awiya e-gaagiimid!

وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ

**104:2**  Wenji-maawanji'idod maamakaadiziwin, agindaasod.

ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ

**104:3**  Inendam omaamakaadiziwin gaawiin wiikaa da-nibosiid.

يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ

**104:4**  Gaawiin. Da-apagidaanaa Al-Hutamahing.

كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ

**104:5**  Aaniin e-gikendaman wegonen Al-Hutamah?

وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ

**104:6**  Allah odishkotem e-jaagideg.

نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ

**104:7**  Dagwishin ode'waang.

ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ

**104:8**  Ishkote gibakwa'igoowaad.

إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ

**104:9**  Gichi-aabajichiganag apii.

فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ

---

## 105. Mishi-bizhiki

**ٱلْفِيل** · Al-Fil · Mekkan · 5 ikidowinan

*Gaawiin na gi-waabandanzii aaniin e-izhi-ayaawaad Ogimaag igi Mishi-bizhikiwag?*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**105:1**  Gaawiin na gi-gikendanzii aaniin e-izhi-ayaawaad Ogimaag igi Mishi-bizhikiwag?

أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

**105:2**  Gaawiin na gii-wanitoosiin odinwewiniwaa?

أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ

**105:3**  Gii-izhinizhmaawaad bineshiwan.

وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ

**105:4**  Gii-apagidaanaawaad asiniin e-boodaabikaadegin.

تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ

**105:5**  Gii-izhi'aawaad debishkoo aniibiin e-daashkigaadegin.

فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ

---

## 106. Quraysh

**قُرَيْش** · Quraysh · Mekkan · 4 ikidowinan

*Onji Quraysh e-ganawenjigaazowaad — e-babaamaadiziwaad biboon gaye niibin.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**106:1**  Mii onji Quraysh e-ganawenjigaazowaad.

لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

**106:2**  E-ganawenjigaazowaad apii e-babaamaadiziwaad biboon gaye niibin.

إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ

**106:3**  Mii dash anama'ewaad Ogimaa omaa wiigiwaam.

فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ

**106:4**  Wegonenjig gii-ashamaawaad bakadewaad, gaye gii-ganawenimaawaad zegiziwaad.

ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

---

## 107. Wiiji'idiwin

**ٱلْمَاعُون** · Al-Ma'un · Mekkan · 7 ikidowinan

*Gi-waabamaa na awiya gaa-wiin-debwe'etang enami'ewin? Wiinawaa wiin gaa-maanaaji'aad ojiiman.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**107:1**  Gi-waabamaa na awiya gaa-wiin-debwe'etang enami'ewin?

أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ

**107:2**  Wiinawaa wiin gaa-maanaaji'aad ojiiman.

فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ

**107:3**  Gaye gaawiin odawiindamawaan ji-miijimowaad getimaagizijig.

وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ

**107:4**  Mii dash nishkaadiziwaad igi e-ayami'ewaad.

فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ

**107:5**  Igi e-wanendangig odayami'ewiniwaa.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ

**107:6**  Igi e-waabanda'iwewaad.

ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ

**107:7**  Gaye gaawiin wiiji'iwewaad.

وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ

---

## 108. Miinigoziwin

**ٱلْكَوْثَر** · Al-Kawthar · Mekkan · 3 ikidowinan

*Ningi-miinigonaan zaam gegoo — mii dash ayami'a Ogimaag, bagidinigen.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**108:1**  Ningi-miinigonaan zaam gegoo.

إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ

**108:2**  Mii dash ayami'a Ogimaag, bagidinigen.

فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ

**108:3**  Awiya e-zhiingenishkid, wiin da-banadizi.

إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ

---

## 109. Gaa-wiin-debwe'endaamosig

**ٱلْكَافِرُون** · Al-Kafirun · Mekkan · 6 ikidowinan

*Ikido: "Gaa-wiin-debwe'endaamosig, gaawiin ninanama'esiin gaa-anama'eyeg."*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**109:1**  Ikido: "Gaa-wiin-debwe'endaamosig,

قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ

**109:2**  Gaawiin ninanama'esiin gaa-anama'eyeg.

لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

**109:3**  Gaye gaawiin anama'esiyeg gaa-anama'eyaan.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:4**  Gaye gaawiin ninanama'esiin gaa-anama'eyeg.

وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ

**109:5**  Gaye gaawiin anama'esiyeg gaa-anama'eyaan.

وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ

**109:6**  Giin gidayaanaawaa gidenami'ewiniwaa, niin nindayaan nindenami'ewin."

لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ

---

## 110. Wiijiwewin

**ٱلنَّصْر** · An-Nasr · Medinan · 3 ikidowinan

*Apii dagwishin Allah owiijiwewin, gaye zhaabwiiwin, gaye giwaabamaag anishinaabeg biindigewaad Allah odenami'ewining memeshkwad.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**110:1**  Apii dagwishin Allah owiijiwewin, gaye zhaabwiiwin.

إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ

**110:2**  Gaye giwaabamaag anishinaabeg biindigewaad Allah odenami'ewining memeshkwad.

وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا

**110:3**  Mii dash mino-inaa Ogimaag, gaye nandotamaaw baanimaagewin. Wiin da-baanimaaged awiya e-aanji-bimaadizid.

فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا

---

## 111. Al-Masad

**ٱلْمَسَد** · Al-Masad · Mekkan · 5 ikidowinan

*Banadiziwaad oninjiiwan Abu Lahab — awiya maamakaadizid, wiijiiweminan e-biidood misan.*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**111:1**  Banadiziwaad oninjiiwan Abu Lahab, gaye wiin banadizi.

تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ

**111:2**  Omaamakaadiziwin gaawiin gii-wiiji'aasiin, gaye gegoo gaa-mamawid.

مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

**111:3**  Da-boodaaso ishkoteng e-jaagideg.

سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ

**111:4**  Gaye wiijiiweminan, e-biidood misan.

وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ

**111:5**  Ningwaming ayaamagad babiinzikawaagan e-mazaanikaadeg.

فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ

---

## 112. Debwewin

**ٱلْإِخْلَاص** · Al-Ikhlas · Mekkan · 4 ikidowinan

*Ikido: "Wiinawaa Allah, bezhig. Allah, As-Samad. Gaawiin oniijaanisiisi, gaye gaawiin gii-niijaanisiisi."*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**112:1**  Ikido: "Wiinawaa Allah, bezhig.

قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ

**112:2**  Allah, As-Samad.

ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ

**112:3**  Gaawiin oniijaanisiisi, gaye gaawiin gii-niijaanisiisi.

لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ

**112:4**  Gaye gaawiin awiya debinaakosii."

وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ

---

## 113. Waaban

**ٱلْفَلَق** · Al-Falaq · Mekkan · 5 ikidowinan

*Ikido: "Ninganawenimigoo Ogimaa waaban, onji e-matchi-ayaag gaa-oshihaad."*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**113:1**  Ikido: "Ninganawenimigoo Ogimaa waaban.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ

**113:2**  Onji e-matchi-ayaag gaa-oshihaad.

مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ

**113:3**  Gaye onji e-matchi-ayaag dibikad e-bi-dibikak.

وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ

**113:4**  Gaye onji e-matchi-ayaag igi e-matchi-mashkikiwewaad.

وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ

**113:5**  Gaye onji e-matchi-ayaad e-nandomaazod."

وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ

---

## 114. Anishinaabeg

**ٱلنَّاس** · An-Nas · Mekkan · 6 ikidowinan

*Ikido: "Ninganawenimigoo Ogimaa anishinaabeg, Gichi-ogimaa anishinaabeg, Allah anishinaabeg."*

بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

*Izhinikaazowining: Allah, Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim.*

**114:1**  Ikido: "Ninganawenimigoo Ogimaa anishinaabeg.

قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:2**  Gichi-ogimaa anishinaabeg.

مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:3**  Allah anishinaabeg.

إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:4**  Onji e-matchi-ayaad e-gimoozid e-gaagiidod.

مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ

**114:5**  Wenji-gaagiidood ode'waang anishinaabeg.

ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ

**114:6**  Wenjiik Jinn, wenjiik anishinaabeg."

مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
